en.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：「你告诉亚伦子孙作祭司的说：祭司不可为民中的死人沾染自己，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：「你告訴亞倫子孫作祭司的說：祭司不可為民中的死人沾染自己，

en.text: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

zhSimplified.text: 除非为他骨肉之亲的父母、儿女、弟兄，

zhTraditional.text: 除非為他骨肉之親的父母、兒女、弟兄，

en.text: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

zhSimplified.text: 和未曾出嫁、作处女的姊妹，才可以沾染自己。

zhTraditional.text: 和未曾出嫁、作處女的姊妹，才可以沾染自己。

en.text: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司既在民中为首，就不可从俗沾染自己。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司既在民中為首，就不可從俗沾染自己。

en.text: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.

zhSimplified.text: 不可使头光秃；不可剃除胡须的周围，也不可用刀划身。

zhTraditional.text: 不可使頭光禿；不可剃除鬍鬚的周圍，也不可用刀劃身。

en.text: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

zhSimplified.text: 要归 神为圣，不可亵渎 神的名；因为耶和华的火祭，就是 神的食物，是他们献的，所以他们要成为圣。

zhTraditional.text: 要歸上帝為聖，不可褻瀆上帝的名；因為耶和華的火祭，就是上帝的食物，是他們獻的，所以他們要成為聖。

en.text: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

zhSimplified.text: 不可娶妓女或被污的女人为妻，也不可娶被休的妇人为妻，因为祭司是归 神为圣。

zhTraditional.text: 不可娶妓女或被污的女人為妻，也不可娶被休的婦人為妻，因為祭司是歸上帝為聖。

en.text: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.

zhSimplified.text: 所以你要使他成圣，因为他奉献你 神的食物；你要以他为圣，因为我—使你们成圣的耶和华—是圣的。

zhTraditional.text: 所以你要使他成聖，因為他奉獻你上帝的食物；你要以他為聖，因為我－使你們成聖的耶和華－是聖的。

en.text: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司的女儿若行淫辱没自己，就辱没了父亲，必用火将她焚烧。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司的女兒若行淫辱沒自己，就辱沒了父親，必用火將她焚燒。

en.text: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

zhSimplified.text: 「在弟兄中作大祭司、头上倒了膏油、又承接圣职、穿了圣衣的，不可蓬头散发，也不可撕裂衣服。

zhTraditional.text: 「在弟兄中作大祭司、頭上倒了膏油、又承接聖職、穿了聖衣的，不可蓬頭散髮，也不可撕裂衣服。

en.text: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

zhSimplified.text: 不可挨近死尸，也不可为父母沾染自己。

zhTraditional.text: 不可挨近死屍，也不可為父母沾染自己。

en.text: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 不可出圣所，也不可亵渎 神的圣所，因为 神膏油的冠冕在他头上。我是耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 不可出聖所，也不可褻瀆上帝的聖所，因為上帝膏油的冠冕在他頭上。我是耶和華。

en.text: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

zhSimplified.text: 他要娶处女为妻。

zhTraditional.text: 他要娶處女為妻。

en.text: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

zhSimplified.text: 寡妇或是被休的妇人，或是被污为妓的女人，都不可娶；只可娶本民中的处女为妻。

zhTraditional.text: 寡婦或是被休的婦人，或是被污為妓的女人，都不可娶；只可娶本民中的處女為妻。

en.text: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”

zhSimplified.text: 不可在民中辱没他的儿女，因为我是叫他成圣的耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 不可在民中辱沒他的兒女，因為我是叫他成聖的耶和華。」

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對摩西說：

en.text: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

zhSimplified.text: 「你告诉亚伦说：你世世代代的后裔，凡有残疾的，都不可近前来献他 神的食物。

zhTraditional.text: 「你告訴亞倫說：你世世代代的後裔，凡有殘疾的，都不可近前來獻他上帝的食物。

en.text: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

zhSimplified.text: 因为凡有残疾的，无论是瞎眼的、瘸腿的、塌鼻子的、肢体有余的、

zhTraditional.text: 因為凡有殘疾的，無論是瞎眼的、瘸腿的、塌鼻子的、肢體有餘的、

en.text: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

zhSimplified.text: 折脚折手的、

zhTraditional.text: 折腳折手的、

en.text: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

zhSimplified.text: 驼背的、矮矬的、眼睛有毛病的、长癣的、长疥的，或是损坏肾子的，都不可近前来。

zhTraditional.text: 駝背的、矮矬的、眼睛有毛病的、長癬的、長疥的，或是損壞腎子的，都不可近前來。

en.text: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

zhSimplified.text: 祭司亚伦的后裔，凡有残疾的，都不可近前来，将火祭献给耶和华。他有残疾，不可近前来献 神的食物。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司亞倫的後裔，凡有殘疾的，都不可近前來，將火祭獻給耶和華。他有殘疾，不可近前來獻上帝的食物。

en.text: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

zhSimplified.text: 神的食物，无论是圣的，至圣的，他都可以吃。

zhTraditional.text: 上帝的食物，無論是聖的，至聖的，他都可以吃。

en.text: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

zhSimplified.text: 但不可进到幔子前，也不可就近坛前；因为他有残疾，免得亵渎我的圣所。我是叫他成圣的耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 但不可進到幔子前，也不可就近壇前；因為他有殘疾，免得褻瀆我的聖所。我是叫他成聖的耶和華。」

en.text: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，摩西晓谕亚伦和亚伦的子孙，并以色列众人。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，摩西曉諭亞倫和亞倫的子孫，並以色列眾人。
